# Plate of Satoh in plane strain (example ex5 of mfem-mgis-examples:
# thermoelasticity, parabolic temperature imposed at the integration points
# as an external state variable, clamped ends, sequential problem solved by
# UMFPack), with its behaviour generated by the generic-parallel interface.
# The executable is the one of mfem-mgis-examples, run in its build
# directory, the behaviour library being given by its option -l; the mode
# of integration is given by the environment variables of mfem-mgis.
set(MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX5_DIR "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_BINARY_DIR}/ex5"
  CACHE PATH "build directory of the example ex5 of mfem-mgis-examples")
add_generic_parallel_mfront_libraries(ex5-behaviours CUDA
  "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_SOURCE_DIR}/ex5/IsotropicLinearThermoElasticity.mfront")

# tests of the example, which checks the temperature seen by the behaviour
# at each integration point and the reactions of the clamped ends, point by
# point (generic library of the example), all the computations by kernels
# with the generic library and by batches with each backend. All the tests
# write their results in the build directory of the example.
proto_check_executable(_usable "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX5_DIR}/satoh")
if(_usable)
  set(_kernels "MFEM_MGIS_GRADIENTS_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_INNER_FORCES_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_TANGENT_OPERATOR_COMPUTATION=Kernels")
  add_test(NAME ex5-point-by-point COMMAND ./satoh
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX5_DIR}")
  add_test(NAME ex5-kernels COMMAND ./satoh
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX5_DIR}")
  set_tests_properties(ex5-point-by-point PROPERTIES
    ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1")
  set_tests_properties(ex5-kernels PROPERTIES
    ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1;MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;${_kernels}")
  set(_tests ex5-point-by-point ex5-kernels)
  foreach(_backend ${ex5-behaviours_BACKENDS})
    set(_library "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generic-parallel-${_backend}/src/libGenericParallelBehaviour-${_backend}.so")
    # two OpenMP threads for the backends on the host
    set(_device)
    set(_threads 2)
    if(_backend STREQUAL "cuda")
      set(_device --device cuda)
      set(_threads 1)
    endif()
    add_test(NAME ex5-batch-${_backend}
      COMMAND ./satoh ${_device} -l "${_library}"
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX5_DIR}")
    set_tests_properties(ex5-batch-${_backend} PROPERTIES
      ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=${_threads};MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;${_kernels}")
    list(APPEND _tests ex5-batch-${_backend})
  endforeach()
  set_tests_properties(${_tests} PROPERTIES RESOURCE_LOCK ex5-outputs)
  # the GPU test holds both locks
  if(TEST ex5-batch-cuda)
    set_tests_properties(ex5-batch-cuda PROPERTIES
      RESOURCE_LOCK "gpu;ex5-outputs")
  endif()
endif()
